style.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF paper sweep for packshots and hanging rows, studio wall #A9DFE1 for on-body scenes, solid brand block #1F9E8B for index and craft screens, matte info-card field #F4F1E9 for spec screens; one background per screen, no scenery

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium fresh-basics menswear apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless product field #FFFFFF, studio wall #A9DFE1, brand block #1F9E8B and info card field #F4F1E9 with text in #2D2D2D; cool high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with large fill, gentle contact shadow grounding every garment, raking side light at 25-30 degrees to reveal knit texture and seams; modern geometric sans-serif with a bold Chinese display headline paired with one thin uppercase English kicker; thin single-weight line icons, numbered circles, plus bullets and 2px outlined tag pills in #1F9E8B; garments presented front-facing at stable scale on an invisible form, laid flat, or on wooden hangers, always cropped below the chin so no face is visible; consistent layout grid with hairline rules and generous margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no visible model face, no garment redesign.
